remaining_uncertainty: No workspace source defines what NODI code 9 means on a no-numeric-result DMR row. The 36 occurrences fall into two structurally opposite contexts (required daily TRC vs optional conditional WET retests), and permit narrative text conditions monitoring for those parameters but never maps either condition to code 9. A single reusable meaning for code 9 cannot be established from admissible evidence.
